description:
The Terraform module files of ragleap-terraform (a local kind cluster plus the RagLeap
        Helm charts) packaged as a jar, with a small class that reads them. This is not a code
        port: it carries the same files as the PyPI package (https://pypi.org/project/ragleap-terraform/)
        under the same paths, and a CI check compares the two. Terraform itself is not included
        or run by this jar.
